body: I think instead of `features` these should be called `customizations`, or `ui_features`, or something more specific. Since they are all only about changing visibility of the UI, not the actual functionality.

diff_hunk:
@@ -140,9 +155,18 @@
 		<member name="display_mode" type="int" setter="set_display_mode" getter="get_display_mode" enum="FileDialog.DisplayMode" default="0">
 			Display mode of the dialog's file list.
 		</member>
+		<member name="favorites_enabled" type="bool" setter="set_feature_enabled" getter="is_feature_enabled" default="true">
+			Toggles visibility of the favorite button, and the favorite list on the left side of the dialog.
body:
```suggestion
			If [code]true[/code], shows the toggle favorite button and favorite list on the left side of the dialog.
```
I wouldn't say this toggles the visibility, it controls the visibility.
Some of the buttons themselves are toggle buttons, so it could be confusing.

Same with the other members.

diff_hunk:
@@ -232,6 +268,27 @@
 		<constant name="DISPLAY_LIST" value="1" enum="DisplayMode">
 			The dialog displays files as a list of filenames.
 		</constant>
+		<constant name="FEATURE_HIDDEN_FILES" value="0" enum="Feature">
+			Toggles visibility of the favorite button, and the favorite list on the left side of the dialog.
body:
```suggestion
			The visibility of the toggle favorite button, and the favorite list on the left side of the dialog. Used with [method set_feature_enabled] and [method is_feature_enabled].
```
`is/set_feature_enabled` doesn't show up in autocomplete, which makes these enums a bit confusing since they do.
Maybe each of the descriptions should point to the functions? Not sure.

Also same as the members, it doesn't really toggle it.

Same with the other enum values.

```suggestion
	ADD_PROPERTYI(PropertyInfo(Variant::BOOL, "file_filter_toggle_enabled"), "set_feature_enabled", "is_feature_enabled", FEATURE_FILE_FILTER);
```
Since the file filter can be opened and then the button can be disabled, it doesn't control the file filter directly.
Or it could also hide the file filter when disabled.

```suggestion
	ADD_PROPERTYI(PropertyInfo(Variant::BOOL, "folder_creation_button_enabled"), "set_feature_enabled", "is_feature_enabled", FEATURE_CREATE_FOLDER);
```
Though if we were to add a right click menu option to create a folder button, would this control that as well?

```suggestion
	ADD_PROPERTYI(PropertyInfo(Variant::BOOL, "recent_list_enabled"), "set_feature_enabled", "is_feature_enabled", FEATURE_RECENT);
```
I think this is more clear.
